strings.name: Karim Benzema
strings.summary: Benzema progressed through Lyon's academy and became a scorer, link player and creator for Real Madrid, winning five Champions Leagues and the 2022 Ballon d'Or. He represented France before moving to Saudi football. His career includes a 2021 suspended sentence for complicity in attempted blackmail; he withdrew his appeal in 2022 while maintaining innocence. His brief Al Hilal contract ended in 2026.
